text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our second summer camp is here. Smart Falcon changes into her swimsuit straightaway, eager to get started.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Recently, the nickname "Silence Suzuka of the Sand" has been gaining popularity among fans. She vows to do the name justice by getting even stronger.
